name: Thai Pongal & Mattu Pongal
description: Tamil harvest festival celebrating the Sun God with freshly boiled sweet Pongal, sugarcane, turmeric plants, and colourful kolam decorations in front of homes.
travel_tip: Visit rural villages near Madurai or Thanjavur to experience traditional earthen pot cooking over open woodfires.

name: Thaipusam
description: Grand festival honoring Lord Murugan with colorful Kavadi Aattam dances, milk pot processions, and devotional chants across Murugan shrines.
travel_tip: Witness the spectacular sea of yellow attire at Palani Murugan Temple or Vadapalani Shrine in Chennai.

name: Alanganallur Jallikattu Festival
description: Ancient Tamil bull-taming sport held during Pongal week, showcasing rural courage, native Kangayam bulls, and village heritage.
travel_tip: Book gallery seats in Alanganallur early in the morning and carry sun hats and bottled water.

name: Margazhi Music & Dance Season
description: World's largest cultural festival featuring over 2,000 Carnatic vocal concerts, Bharatanatyam recitals, and traditional sabha tiffin canteens.
travel_tip: Visit Music Academy and Narada Gana Sabha for morning lectures and evening vocal concerts accompanied by hot Ghee Roast Dosa.

name: Natyanjali Dance Festival
description: Five-day classical dance festival held inside Chidambaram Nataraja Temple celebrating Lord Shiva through captivating Bharatanatyam performances.
travel_tip: Stay till midnight during Maha Shivaratri to watch India's top classical dancers perform in the temple courtyard.

name: Mahamaham Festival
description: Sacred tank festival held every 12 years in Kumbakonam, attracting millions of devotees to dip in the holy Mahamaham tank.
travel_tip: Sample Kumbakonam degree coffee and explore the surrounding Chola temple circuit.

name: Mamallapuram Indian Dance Festival
description: Month-long beachfront cultural festival held against the open-air backdrop of 7th-century rock reliefs at Arjuna's Penance.
travel_tip: Attend weekend evening shows under the starry sky right after exploring the Shore Temple.

name: Panguni Uthiram
description: Celestial wedding anniversary of divine couples celebrated with grand temple chariot processions (Thiru Ther) and flower palanquins.
travel_tip: Visit Mylapore Kapaleeshwarar Temple in Chennai to see the giant wooden chariot pulled by thousands of devotees.

name: Chithirai Festival
description: 15-day extravaganza celebrating the celestial wedding of Goddess Meenakshi & Lord Sundareswarar, followed by Lord Kallazhagar entering the Vaigai River.
travel_tip: Head to Vaigai riverbed early morning on the 10th day to witness Lord Kallazhagar's golden horse entry.

name: Thanjavur Chithirai Car Festival
description: Massive wooden temple chariot car festival around the four Car Streets surrounding the 1,000-year-old Brihadeeswarar Temple.
travel_tip: Photograph the 40-foot tall carved wooden chariot as it rounds the historic granite temple precincts.

name: Aadi Perukku Water Festival
description: Monsoon river festival giving thanks to River Kaveri for life-giving water, featuring family picnics, variety rice dishes, and floating lamp offerings.
travel_tip: Join local families along Amma Mandapam ghats in Srirangam, Trichy, to taste traditional lemon and tamarind rice.

name: Velankanni Shrine Annual Feast
description: 10-day festival honoring Our Lady of Good Health at the famous coastal basilica, drawing millions of pilgrims of all faiths.
travel_tip: Attend the evening illuminated car procession along the Coromandel coast beach.

name: Kulasekharapatnam Dasara
description: Vibrant 10-day Dussehra carnival where devotees wear elaborate costumes of Kali, kings, and mythological gods, dancing to loud folk drums.
travel_tip: Carry a camera to capture the surreal folk costumes and late-night seaside trance dance rituals.

name: Karthigai Deepam
description: Festival of lights where a colossal Mahadeepam beacon flame is lit atop the 2,600-foot holy Annamalai Hill, visible for 30 km.
travel_tip: Join the 14-km Girivalam barefoot circumambulation around the sacred hill on the full moon night.

name: Nagore Kanthuri Festival
description: Grand Sufi festival featuring the ceremonial procession of the sandalwood-encrusted chariot (Santhanakoodu) to the Nagore Dargah.
travel_tip: Witness the inclusive communal harmony as people of all religions gather to receive sacred sandalwood paste.
